commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Matheus Mane (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Caoimhin Kelleher intercepts the ball.
90+5' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90+3' Matthew Donohue blows for a foul after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
89' Substitution. Matt Doherty will be replaced by Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves).
89' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Hee-Chan Hwang as he is replaced by Jhon Arias (Wolves).

88' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Caoimhin Kelleher to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
88' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
88' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Wolves, he's going to review using VAR.

87' Matthew Donohue blows his whistle after Caoimhin Kelleher (Brentford) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. PENALTY! One of the players from Wolves is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
83' 0 - 2 Goal! Mikkel Damsgaard puts a cross into the box and finds Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) replaces Ki-Jana Hoever.
80' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

79' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
78' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is penalised for holding. Matthew Donohue signals a set piece. Wolves have a free kick.

77' Matheus Mane picks out David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
74' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
74' A first-time shot by David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
73' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Rico Henry (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthew Donohue had an easy-decision to make.
71' Igor Thiago (Brentford) picks up a long through ball, but Jose Sa deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
69' Matheus Mane (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
67' Matheus Mane (Wolves) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
65' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Fernando Lopez is replaced by Matheus Mane (Wolves).
64' Substitution. Mathias Jensen makes his way off the pitch and Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) comes on as his replacement.
63' 0 - 1 Goal! Vitaly Janelt puts a cross into the box and finds Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
62' The ball possession at the moment is 39:61.
60' Brentford seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
57' Rico Henry (Brentford) commits a foul during an attacking move.

55' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets to a rebound and attempts to score with a header. Caoimhin Kelleher is in the right place at the right time and keeps out the effort which was heading towards the middle of the target.
52' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

51' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jose Sa shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
50' Wolves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) commits a foul and Matthew Donohue immediately signals a free kick.
48' Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Referee Matthew Donohue blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
44' The referee is firm and issues Michael Kayode (Brentford) a deserved yellow card.
44' Matthew Donohue shows a yellow card to Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
44' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) dribbles into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
41' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

39' What a wasted opportunity by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Jose Sa makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
38' A cross from a corner kick by Brentford is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Andre (Wolves) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
30' Rico Henry (Brentford) brings an opponent down and Matthew Donohue interrupts the game. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Wolves.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brentford.
27' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
25' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Gomes (Wolves) was quite harsh and Matthew Donohue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
23' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) sends a chip pass into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher is quickest to intercept the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolves.
20' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Yellow card. Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
18' Matthew Donohue blows his whistle and it's Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
15' The Brentford players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
13' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
11' Joao Gomes (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matthew Donohue signals. Brentford have a free kick.
9' The free kick from long range, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Matt Doherty (Wolves) was too aggressive in his challenge. Brentford get a free kick.
6' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Foul! Igor Thiago (Brentford) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Wolves.

4' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolves.
2' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Matthew Donohue had a clear view and blows his whistle.

Brentford will kick-off.
Matthew Donohue will officiate today.
